title: scleranthus annuus subsp. collinus
intro: Scleranthus annuus subsp. collinus, commonly known as Alpine Knawel, is a plant species within the carnation family, Caryophyllaceae. Alpine Knawel is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its properties as a mild sedative and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Knawel include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
